papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 面向未来：离心阻力训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 离心阻力训练被认为是提高成年人肌肉力量和爆发力的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚不清楚。目的 本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心阻力训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向能力）的影响。方法 从电子搜索引擎检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原始期刊文章。

papers.title_en: What Is "Zone 2 Training"?: Experts' Viewpoint on Definition, Training Methods, and Expected Adaptations.
papers.title_zh: 什么是“第二区训练”？：专家对定义、训练方法和预期适应的观点
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en:
BACKGROUND
The role of high-volume low-intensity training for enhancing endurance performance has gained growing interest in recent years. Specifically, so-called "zone 2 training" is currently receiving much attention, and many propose that this is the target intensity at which a large proportion of total endurance training should be performed. However, despite the popularity of this concept, there is no clear consensus among coaches, athletes, and scientists regarding the definition of zone 2 training.


PURPOSE
This commentary summarizes the perspectives, experience, and knowledge of an expert panel of 14 applied sport scientists and professional coaches with the aim of providing insight and a basis for definitional consensus on zone 2 training. papers.abstract_zh:
背景 近年来，大容量低强度训练在提高耐力表现方面的作用日益受到关注。特别是，所谓的“第二区训练”目前备受瞩目，许多人提出这应该是大部分耐力训练应达到的目标强度。然而，尽管这一概念很流行，但在教练、运动员和科学家之间，关于第二区训练的定义尚未达成明确共识。
目的 本评论总结了专家们的观点、经验和知识。

papers.title_en: Writing High-Quality Case Studies in Sport Science.
papers.title_zh: 运动科学中高质量案例研究的撰写
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en:
PURPOSE
Sport-physiology and -performance research often relies on group designs that compare experimental and control groups and/or preintervention and postintervention results. This commentary highlights the key elements of a high-quality case study and provides clear guidelines for readers and authors of the International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance. We propose 4 essential components. First, case studies should offer relevant and original insights by tackling novel issues and defining a clear purpose. papers.abstract_zh: 目的 运动生理学和运动表现研究通常依赖于比较实验组与对照组和/或干预前后结果的群体设计。本评论强调了高质量案例研究的关键要素，并为《国际运动生理学与表现杂志》的读者和作者提供了明确的指导。我们提出了4个基本组成部分。首先，案例研究应通过解决新颖问题和明确目的来提供相关且原创的见解。其次，它们必须采用严谨的方法，包括对细节的仔细把控。

papers.title_en: Mixed Training Programs Applied to Young Soccer Players: Effects on Speed-Power Abilities
papers.title_zh: 应用于年轻足球运动员的混合训练方案：对速度-爆发力能力的影响
papers.abstract_en: Abstract We compared the effects of two 4-week strength-power-speed training protocols on physical performance of young soccer players. Twenty-three highly trained under-20 soccer players were randomly allocated to two mixed-training groups: 1) “traditional” (TRAD: n=11), comprising vertically oriented strength-power exercises and linear sprints; or 2) “multidirectional” (MULTI: n=12), combining vertically and horizontally oriented strength-power exercises, linear sprints, and change-of-direction (COD) drills. Squat jump (SJ) and countermovement jump, 2) linear sprint, COD speed, and 3) jump-squat (JS) and hip-thrust (HT) power tests were performed pre- and post-training. Differences were determined using a two-way ANOVA with repeated measures and “target scores” were used to detect real changes in performance. papers.title_en: Light load jump squat and plyometric training enhance jumping, sprinting, change of direction, and balance performance of male soccer players (U-19): a randomized controlled trial.
papers.title_zh: 轻负荷跳深蹲和增强式训练提高U-19男子足球运动员的跳跃、冲刺、变向和平衡表现：一项随机对照试验
papers.journal: Journal of Sports Medicine and Physical Fitness
papers.abstract_en:
BACKGROUND
In sports science, optimizing athletic performance is pursued through an emerging approach that combined light-loaded squat (LLS) training and plyometric jump training (PJT), targeting strength, power, and neuromuscular adaptations, particularly beneficial for the dynamic demands of youth soccer. The aim of this study was to examine the effect of a combined LLS training and PJT program on athletic performance and balance in youth soccer players.


METHODS
Thirty-two male players were randomly assigned to two groups: an experimental group (EG: N.=16; age: 18.56±0.51 years; body mass: 66.87±4.99 kg; height: 1.78±0.07 m) and a control group (CG: N.=16; age: 18.68±0.47 years; body mass: 67.93±4.58 kg; height: 1.77±0.07 m) from the same U19 team of a professional club voluntarily participated in the study.
